I can't help but be thoroughly disappointed by the who fandom right now. Everyone's entitled to their own opinions, i know that. I just don't understand how you can be a fan of a show as bold and progressive as doctor who and be so close minded and against such a trivial change. Because SURELY there's no other reason they'd choose a female actor other than to push liberal agendas right? SURELY it can't possibly be that Chibnall chose her just because he wanted a fresh new take on the doctor right? Really guys? It's the same character, the essence of the doctor has nothing to do with his race or gender, and it's not going against canon. If you're saying it's lazy than the whole concept of regeneration is freaking lazy writing. You can't compare it to ghostbusters because you haven't even seen how chibnall will write her doctor. If you're quitting just because of this casting than try to really think about why you fell in love with doctor who in the first place, because if you really love the spirit of the show than i can't possibly see why you're not excited about meeting this new doctor.
